requirements.quote:
If a local system TCP user interface supports the TCP PUSH function,
   then each BGP message SHOULD be transmitted with PUSH flag set.
requirements.condition: If the local system TCP user interface supports the TCP PUSH function.
requirements.required_behavior: Each BGP message SHOULD be transmitted with the PUSH flag set.
requirements.why_checkable: TCP transmission flags can be inspected for BGP messages when PUSH is supported.

requirements.quote:
If a local system TCP user interface supports setting the DSCP field
   [RFC2474] for TCP connections, then the TCP connection used by BGP
   SHOULD be opened with bits 0-2 of the DSCP field set to 110 (binary).
requirements.condition: If the local system TCP user interface supports setting the DSCP field for TCP connections.
requirements.required_behavior: The TCP connection used by BGP SHOULD be opened with bits 0-2 of the DSCP field set to 110 (binary).
requirements.why_checkable: The DSCP bits configured on BGP TCP connections can be inspected when the interface supports DSCP configuration.

requirements.quote: An implementation MUST support the TCP MD5 option [RFC2385].
requirements.required_behavior: The implementation MUST support the TCP MD5 option [RFC2385].
requirements.why_checkable: The implementation can be checked for support of the TCP MD5 option.
